units.source_text: 这时候，驹子踉踉跄跄地走了两三步，就哇哇地想要呕吐，但什么也没吐出来，眼睛湿润，脸上起了鸡皮疙瘩。

en.t: At that moment, Komako staggered two or three steps and retched as if she were going to vomit, but nothing came out; her eyes were wet, and gooseflesh rose on her face.

units.source_text: 叶子紧张起来，木呆呆地望着驹子。

en.t: Yoko grew tense and stared blankly at Komako.

units.source_text: 但是，由于那副表情过分认真，不知是怒是惊，还是悲伤！

en.t: But because that expression was so terribly earnest, it was impossible to tell whether it was anger, shock, or sadness.

units.source_text: 像假面具一样，显得非常单纯。

en.t: Like a mask, it looked starkly simple.
